recommended_update: Before starting all source and installed artifact subprocesses in a filesystem-restricted environment, export a writable UV_CACHE_DIR under the task workspace and preserve it in the launcher environment; a cache variable used only during dependency setup does not propagate to later exec sessions. Probe a harmless uv command using the same child environment before the full invocation.

verified_correction: Re-execute only the four affected packaging nodes in a new output directory with UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/uv-cache; all four reach their original installed-product I6-C call failures, with zero setup errors. limits: This repairs only cache placement. It neither changes product guards/SQLite nor turns retained product failures into PASS; any other failures need their own evidence.
